data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 1.7m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013: GBP 3.3m). This release is a consequence of favourable development in Superstorm Sandy claims.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Release of reserves due to favourable development in Superstorm Sandy claims

named_events.loss_description: Release of reserves following favourable development in Superstorm Sandy claims

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 gross claims outstanding were GBP 8.099m. During 2014 there was a net release of GBP 1.7m (approximately 21% of opening gross claims) driven by favourable development on Superstorm Sandy claims, resulting in lower claims outstanding at year end. The release is reported net in the claims note; no gross prior-year movement figure is disclosed.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 1.7m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013: GBP 3.3m).
This release is a consequence of favourable development in Superstorm Sandy claims.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported in the notes as a NET release of GBP 1.7m (explicit). No gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement figure is disclosed in the notes; consequently the net figure has been used and flagged. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the prior-year comparative column of the balance sheet (claims outstanding = GBP 8,099k). Gross premium mix is aggregated to a single 'Reinsurance' line because the report classifies all business as reinsurance accepted (US property catastrophe) and no regulatory segmental breakdown was provided in the available text.
